label: D2 after a rare a1->S2 transition, late in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D2 (never D1/GO), and only when S2 is the state shown (100% of mass). 96% of mass is on rare a1->S2 transitions; the few a2->S2 common activations are tiny (lowest quartile). It is strongly gated by time in the episode: no activity before trial ~55, with the rate climbing through trials 60-99 (most mass at trials 80-99). Activations are larger when the previous trial was rewarded (prev_reward=1 holds 91% of mass) and when the model value is low (<7.1). The predicate D2 & a1 & S2 & ep_trial>=80 gives dev F1 0.57, mass recall 0.84; the >=70 variant reaches mass recall 0.94 but precision 0.40. Adding prev_reward==1 raises precision to 0.66 but lowers mass recall to 0.75. Many rare a1->S2 steps late in the episode stay silent, so precision is incomplete. Every variable is observed at D2, so no future variables are used.
